name: portfolio-blog-post-card
title: Blog Post Card
description: An article preview card with publication metadata.
docs: Imported from the portfolio project. Customize personal copy, links, social profiles, booking URLs, and data before use. Requires React 19, Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn theme variables. Files install under your components alias in lazy-ui/, with their relative imports preserved. Import the installed lazy-ui/styles/portfolio.css in your global stylesheet. For Base UI animation utilities, also import shadcn/tailwind.css. Configure NOTION_SECRET (or NOTION_API_KEY), NOTION_DATA_SOURCE_ID and/or NOTION_BLOG_DATA_SOURCE_ID. Keep these helpers server-side; the blog cache functions require cacheComponents: true.
